scheme_name: Scheme of Providing Assistance to Encourage Farmers for Adoption of Organic Farming
other_conditions: Applicant must have an interest in practicing certified organic farming system.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹2,000 per hectare for certification fees, ₹5,000 per hectare as input subsidy, and up to ₹10,000 per year for residue testing.
